notes.title: Regarding frame rate and screen tearing issues
notes.content:
In order to thoroughly reproduce video camera images, the maximum fps of this game is fixed at 30 fps, which is the same as that of ordinary video cameras.
However, I am planning to implement an option to set the maximum fps, as this specification has been reported to cause some problems, such as misinterpretation of screen tearing and motion sickness caused by the low frame rate.
